title: Transferring climate change physical knowledge
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
testbed_rationale: Provides a reproducible benchmark combining multi-model CMIP6 climate projection grids and observational constraints for training, validating, and emulating global/regional climate responses under multiple SSP scenarios, complete with Zenodo data archive and GitHub code.
pain_points: Structural and parametric model biases in CMIP6 models (e.g., equatorial Pacific cold tongue, Arctic Amplification underestimation, Gulf Stream separation errors)
Significant uncertainty and wide inter-model spread in CMIP6 climate sensitivity and future projections
Limited observational historical records (BEST data reliable only from 1979 to 2022, creating risk of overfitting during fine-tuning)
Single forcing pathway assumption per SSP without spatially explicit observational constraints on historical aerosol distributions
extraction_notes: The architecture converts a scalar CO2 equivalent value into a 2D global surface temperature map using dense layers and four transposed convolutional (deconvolutional) layers, followed by a refinement convolution.
